div.head: III Atr 6
div.ab: Et omnis accusatus (uel qui alium impetit) habeat optionem, quid uelit, siue iudicium aque uel ferri.
⁊ ælc tíond áge geweald, swa hwæðer he wille swa wæter swa ísen.
⁊ ælc tíond áge geweald, swa hwæðer he wille, swa wæter swa ísen.
And every accuser shall have the choice of whichever ordeal he desires (for the accused)—either ordeal by water or by iron.
And every accuser is to have the choice whether he wishes the ordeal to be of water or of iron.
Und jeder Kläger habe Entscheidung, welches [Ordal], entweder Wasser oder Eisen, er [vom Angeklagten erbracht haben] will.
And let every plaintiff have the choice of which [ordeal] he wants [the accused to undergo], either water or iron.
